from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One EPS figure extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label for the EPS metric (e.g., 'Net loss per common share')")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The EPS value as a signed float; negative indicates a loss")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this figure")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EPSRecord]
